column1: # Czech (cs) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_cs` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | few (2–4) | other (0, 5+).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of the English labels, following common Czech desktop
# conventions (menus are nouns, commands are infinitives); not taken from Adobe Acrobat's Czech
# localisation or any other product's translation. Terminology: annotations are "komentáře",
# pages are "stránky", form fields are "formulářová pole". Product and format names (PdfCraft,
# PDF, Word, HTML…) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
